descripcion: El que murmura. LLAVE de la escena: hasta que no da el numero, las puertas estan cerradas. Reescrito porque Whitehead se quedaba callado ante dos cosas ante las que un cura NO se calla: que Dios ha abandonado a alguien, y tres muertos de una misma casa. Ademas, aqui es donde se declara que Whitehead cree en el miasma: lo dice el, no un cartel.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

overheard.texto: God has abandoned this street, Reverend.

opciones.texto: What do you think is causing this?

the_air.texto: The smell from the drains. Everyone says it is the bad air.

waited.texto: At least you do not tell me I am wrong.

losses.texto: I have lived here forty-one years. I have never seen so many die in one week.

anota.que: Many deaths on Broad Street this week, more than anyone remembers.

apology.texto: I am going to every house that has lost someone.

opciones.texto: A woman who takes in garments sent word to the church. Which house is hers?
Someone sent for me from a house with rags at the windows. Which number?

_guia: Las opciones dicen por qué la busca: le mandaron recado.
